oracle.invariant: S1: google-places answers first; without a key the chain goes straight to OSM and names the skipped tier only when google was chosen; a quota error falls back to Apify or OSM with fallbackFrom. S2: a rectangle restriction, 20 then up to 60 rows across pages, 400 INVALID_SEARCH for the bad radius and cuisine. S3: web.none 40, web.socialOnly 40 + marketing 20 → 91 A, web.down 40, web.slow 25 with the three signals, web.fine 0 → 31 C, pending with no web part, the chain and the closed place halved with their penalty reasons. S4: the two KFC rows are chain and chainSuspect, the three Phở 77 rows are chainSuspect only and keep their name, independents unmarked, input untouched. S5: only the first N unknown addresses are queued per call, the rest answer not_queued; the second call reports done/down/blocked/failed with the measured fields and no score; a 61st address is 400 INVALID_URLS; the 601st call in the hour is 429 RATE_LIMITED. S6: bytes with the credit header and Cache-Control private; the name falls back once to the place id; no key is 503 CREDENTIAL_MISSING; a bad name is 400 INVALID_PHOTO_NAME; the key never appears in a URL or an error. S7: every reason key has a line with signed points; rows without a value sort last on every key; kind counts follow the tab order. S8: rows get a stable key, the chain count, pages and centre; a row sent without a score still gets one so every cell can draw; a failed search keeps its code.
